title: Plynth build preview parts, version 1
description: build/preview/parts.json, written by the build with the preview parts: one FBX per floor, one for the slab above it and one for its roofs, with the same materials and images as build/building.fbx, so build/materials.json applies to them too. The app's 3D view loads them to hide roofs and to cut the building at the shown floor; the plan overlay loads one floor's storey part. Parts are in floor order, then storey, slab, roof; a floor without roof sections has no roof part and one without a slab no slab part. Files without slab parts have the slab in the storey.

kind.description: storey: everything of the floor but its slab, roofs and collision (walls, fills, floors, ceilings, items, stairs). slab: the slab above the floor. roof: its roof sections.

file.description: A file name inside build/preview/, no folder.
